traversal_direction_stated: IMPORT-direction traversal rooted at the realization roots, plus the three declared subprocess edges (the blender scripts, which are also roots since they execute out-of-process). Why this direction answers 'what does producing a rendered palette reach': same-process Python execution requires import, so everything realization can execute in-process is import-reachable from its roots; the only cross-process execution is the declared subprocess edges. This is NOT a call-direction instrument: call edges are not obtained, and the known failure modes of the import instrument are (i) dynamic imports — the computation re-runs the constant-literal dynamic-import scan and STOPS on any non-constant occurrence in the closure, per the reachability arc's precedent; (ii) reflection/getattr dispatch — no known instance in services; named as residual, not discharged
